summary: UI-control state-change handler gated by the enable byte at this+0xE0. When enabled it snapshots the current state via ShortComputation_7720, normalizes a lookup string (this+0xA0, falling back to byte_5EA438 when null) through StringNormalizeLookup_a460 using a context base 5772 bytes into the object at this+0x40, and when normalization succeeds compares it against a second string (this+0xA8, also falling back to byte_5EA438) via sub_588410, dispatching StateDependentVTableDispatch_7760 with the comparison result. If a second ShortComputation_7720 snapshot differs from the first, it fires the virtual notification at vtable offset +44 with argument 1. Always returns 0.

local_names.this: UI-control object with enable flag, lookup base, two string fields and a vtable
local_names.v2: first state snapshot used to detect change
local_names.v3: first normalized target string (fallback byte_5EA438 when null)
local_names.v5: second comparison string (fallback byte_5EA438 when null)

operations.description: Enable flag at this+0xE0: when zero the entire handler body is skipped and the function returns 0

StringNormalizeLookup_a460 resolves the source string against a context object read 5772 bytes into the object pointed to by this+0x40
Normalization result guard: dispatch and comparison only run when v4 is non-null
Comparison target loaded from this+0xA8, defaulting to byte_5EA438 when null
sub_588410 compares the normalized lookup result against the comparison target; equality is indicated by a zero return
StateDependentVTableDispatch_7760 dispatched with the equality flag (v6 == 0) derived from the string comparison
Change detection: a second ShortComputation_7720 snapshot is compared against the first; notification fires only when they differ
Virtual notification invoked through the vtable pointer stored at this+0x0 at slot +44, passing argument 1
Function returns literal 0 on every path
Invoked by InitDispatchWithVTableCheck and sub_487D50 as the state-change handler for a UI control
